versions.notes: Tag-structure pass (0.5.6): added a warning-level element-contract gate that harvests class→element usage from the pinned package. CORRECTED by 0.5.7: the harvested approach is unsound and its headline finding was a false positive — usa-file-input on a wrapper div is the post-JS-init state, which is the only structure the stylesheet targets (.usa-file-input .usa-file-input__input), so that tile was correct. Harvested tag usage under-determines the legal element set in both directions: including demo templates flags legal alternatives (usa-nav__link on <a>), excluding them discards real evidence. Superseded by curated contracts
